text: On a Connecticut farm in 1935, the twins Niles and Holland Perry spend the summer near their grandmother Ada, who has taught Niles [the Game|trigger|calling on unseen powers], a family gift for sending the mind into other creatures. A cousin dies in a freak accident, a neighbour's heart gives out, and the boys' mother is paralysed. Ada comes to see [Holland's careless, violent nature living on inside his brother|threat|the enemy within], and when [Niles' newborn niece vanishes|who_suffers|young children], she reaches for [a kerosene lamp|images|fire, smoke and burning].
